FN-3BX8VZ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 290
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/10/2023
Senate Bill 290 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development increases the competitive bidding floor for public works contracts from $50,000,
under current law, to $100,000, as well as allowing for the solicitation and submission of sealed
bids. In addition, it authorizes those dollar amounts to be further increased based on increases in
Consumer Price Index. This bill could increase or decrease the purchase price of goods and
services procured for public work projects, depending on the difference in (1) the cost of
products procured under the provisions of this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under
current law.

FN-3BX8VZ-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 290
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/23/2023
Senate Bill 290 as passed the Senate would increase the competitive bidding floor for public
works contracts from $50,000, under current law, to $100,000, as well as allowing for the
solicitation and submission of sealed bids by electronic means. In addition, this bill would allow
the bid floor amounts to be further increased based on increases in Consumer Price Index. This
bill could increase or decrease the purchase price of goods and services procured for public
work projects, depending on the difference in (1) the cost of products procured under the
provisions of this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under current law.
